arvus-lighter-squadron.name: Arvus Lighter Squadron
arvus-lighter-squadron.transport: This unit can transport up to 12 friendly RENEGADES AND HERETICS INFANTRY models. Each weapons team model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models. It cannot transport OGRN models.

valkyrie-squadron.name: Valkyrie Squadron
valkyrie-squadron.transport: This unit can transport up to 12 friendly RENEGADES AND HERETICS INFANTRY models. Each weapons team model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each OGRYN model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

chimera.name: Chimera
chimera.transport: This unit can transport up to 12 friendly RENEGADES AND HERETICS INFANTRY models. Each weapons team model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each OGRYN model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

warp-possession.name: Warp Possession
warp-possession.text: If the Perils of the Warp Command Asset is played after this model manifests a psychic power, it replaces its Bare Hands weapon with the Warp-empowered Fists weapon for the rest of the battle.

choir-of-chaos.name: Choir of Chaos
choir-of-chaos.text: When this unit manifests a psychic power you can place a blast marker next to it. If you do, after the psychic power is resolved roll one D12; on an 11+ return that Command Asset to your hand instead of discarding it. That Command Asset cannot be played again this turn.

1-razor-claws.name: 1 - Razor Claws
1-razor-claws.text: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by this unit with melee weapons.

2-grasping-pseudopods.name: 2 - Grasping Pseudopods
2-grasping-pseudopods.text: Add 1 to this unit’s Attacks characteristic.

3-toxic-haemorrhage.name: 3 - Toxic Haemorrhage
3-toxic-haemorrhage.text: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by this unit with melee weapons.

mutated-beyond-reason.name: Mutated Beyond Reason
mutated-beyond-reason.text: When this unit makes a Fight action, before picking targets, roll one D3 on the table below to determine what mutation it gains until the end of that action.

banner-of-the-apostate.name: Banner of the Apostate
banner-of-the-apostate.text: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of Imperial units whilst they are within 6" of any units that have a Banner of the Apostate.

banner-of-hate.name: Banner of Hate
banner-of-hate.text: In the Damage phase, damage must be resolved for units that have a Banner of Hate before damage is resolved for any other units (including SUPER-HEAVY units). If a unit that has a Banner of Hate is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, roll a D12 for each other LIGHT unit within 3" of that unit; on a 10+ place one blast marker next to the unit being rolled for.

baleful-judge.name: Baleful Judge
baleful-judge.text: When a Morale test is taken for a RENEGADES AND HERETICS INFANTRY unit whilst it is within 3" of any friendly units with this ability, if the unmodified roll is a 6 you must take the test again for that unit. Before taking the test again, place one blast marker next to that unit.

in-it-for-the-money.name: In It For The Money
in-it-for-the-money.text: Subtract 1 from Morale tests taken for this unit.

shower-of-bile.name: Shower of Bile
shower-of-bile.text: At the end of the Action phase, if this unit has any blast markers next to it, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 1" of this unit; on a 6 place one blast marker next to the unit being rolled for.

weapon-teams.name: Weapon Teams
weapon-teams.text: For the purposes of determining what models a unit can transport, models in this unit are weapons team models.

covenant-of-tzeentch.name: Covenant of Tzeentch
covenant-of-tzeentch.text: Add 1 to saving throws made for COVENANT OF TZEENTCH units in this unit’s Detachment.

covenant-of-slaanesh.name: Covenant of Slaanesh
covenant-of-slaanesh.text: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of COVENANT OF SLAANESH units in this unit’s Detachment.

covenant-of-nurgle.name: Covenant of Nurgle
covenant-of-nurgle.text: COVENANT OF NURGLE units in this unit’s Detachment have the Ignore Damage (6+) ability.

covenant-of-khorne.name: Covenant of Khorne
covenant-of-khorne.text: Re-roll hit rolls and wound rolls of 1 for attacks made with melee weapons by COVENANT OF KHORNE units in this unit’s Detachment.

avalanche-of-muscle.name: Avalanche of Muscle
avalanche-of-muscle.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by this unit if its Detachment is carrying out an Assault order.

combat-stimms.name: Combat Stimms
combat-stimms.text: At the start of the Action phase, this unit can use combat stimms. It if does, roll one D6; on a 1, place one blast marker next to this unit; on a 2-6, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit until the end of the phase.

artillery-battery.name: Artillery Battery
artillery-battery.text: Each slot in a Detachment allows you to take up to three of this unit in your army, instead of one. Each unit taken for a single slot must be placed at the same time and within 6" of each other unit taken for the same slot the first time they are set up.

vehicle-squadron.name: Vehicle Squadron
vehicle-squadron.text: Each slot in a Detachment allows you to take up to three of this unit in your army, instead of one. Each unit taken for a single slot must be placed at the same time and within 6" of each other unit taken for the same slot the first time they are set up.
